title: SKET DANCE
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: At Kaimei Academy, the three-member 'Sket Brigade' club takes on any student request: leader Bossun with his bursts of concentration, hot-headed ex-delinquent Himeko, and Switch, an otaku who speaks through a computer voice app. The long-running comedy mixes parody and farce with sentimental school drama and tragic backstories, and won the 2009 Shogakukan Manga Award (MANGA MILLION and MU blurbs; THEM Anime review of the adaptation).
life_message: Helping others with whatever they need, and leaning on friends through past grief, makes school life meaningful.

content.note: Comedic violence, mostly Himeko's hockey stick (THEM, anime); MU Delinquent/s.
Tragic pasts and deaths of loved ones (THEM; MU Dead Family Member/s; AniList Tragedy, spoiler).
Light fan service (THEM, anime); MU Subtle Romance.
Crude and scatological jokes in later episodes (THEM, anime).
Grief and trauma in each lead's past (THEM); MU Death of Loved One/s.
One character fat-shamed for laughs (THEM, anime).

dominant: Service to classmates; friendship through grief; parody comedy
